slot_scores.name: missing_minimization_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the objective — should I minimize the total number of salespeople scheduled (i.e., the sum of all shift starts), or is there a cost per shift type, or some other goal?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the objective and specifically whether to minimize total salespeople scheduled.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only hidden P0 slot was explicitly resolved before READY_TO_MODEL; the agent then stopped after confirming the objective and other modeling details.

summary: The agent asked targeted clarification questions and explicitly recovered the hidden minimization objective before proceeding to model, resulting in an appropriate stop with no unresolved P0/P1 slots.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
